engine.notes: Henderson has no improv organisation of its own that could be verified; the scene clusters at Mom's Basement Theatre on West Sahara, where CSz Las Vegas plays and jams run three nights a week. Delirious Comedy Club runs a mixed stand-up and improv night but is a stand-up club, and Las Vegas Improvisation Players and Profoundry Works could not be verified on a site of their own.

entries.name: Mom's Basement Theatre
entries.summary: Community-powered comedy venue on West Sahara that hosts ComedySportz Las Vegas, three weekly improv jams, Latine and Filipino showcases, and beginner-to-advanced classes run with CSz.
entries.schedule: Jams: Mystery Meet Thursdays, Sip Zap Zop Fridays (21+), Third Beat Sundays; shows most weekends
signals: Three weekly improv jams plus monthly specialty jams
Home theatre of ComedySportz Las Vegas
entries.reasons: The city's one true improv room with jams three nights a week and a busy show list, but young, small and with a calendar page that would not load.

entries.name: CSz Las Vegas (ComedySportz)
entries.summary: The ComedySportz franchise for Las Vegas: two-team improvised comedy matches at Mom's Basement Theatre, a Minor League, fall curriculum classes from complete beginner to advanced, and corporate training.
entries.schedule: Matches at Mom's Basement Theatre; fall classes open for registration
signals: Classes for all ages and levels
entries.reasons: A franchise format with a steady match schedule and a class ladder, but no dates on its site and a shared, recently opened venue.

entries.name: Vegas Improv Power
entries.summary: Life-skills improv school founded 2018 that runs six-week 'yes, let's' and 'let's play' courses at the Las Vegas Little Theatre Studio, plus Zoom classes, coaching and corporate work; not performance-focused.
entries.schedule: yes, let's Oct 14-Nov 18, 2026; let's play Nov 7-Dec 19, 2026; $299 per six-week course
signals: Classes at Las Vegas Little Theatre Studio, 3890 Schiff Drive
entries.reasons: A current, dated class calendar from an eight-year-old school, but no shows, no levels beyond continuing classes and a borrowed studio.

entries.name: Vegas Theatre Hub
entries.summary: Downtown Arts District performance hub with an improv program, online improv and writing classes and late-night shows such as Stinky and Bunny.
entries.schedule: Online improv classes by registration; late-night shows announced on the site
entries.reasons: A decade-old venue with an improv strand, but thin public detail on classes and only occasional shows.

entries.name: Bleach Improv
entries.summary: Long-form improv ensemble of six performers and a pianist who have played together about twelve years, with a monthly show on third Thursdays.
entries.reasons: A durable team with a monthly slot but no venue, no classes shown and no dates on its site.
